digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, Design

stories.headline: Anthropic Signals Proximity to Recursive Self-Improvement
stories.blurb: Anthropic disclosed in an updated IPO filing that it may soon hit internal benchmarks for self-improving AI systems capable of developing next-generation models.

stories.headline: Anthropic S-1 Update Reveals $33B Revenue and $895B Compute Commitments
stories.blurb: Anthropic's amended IPO prospectus showed 1,200% revenue growth to $33.24 billion alongside a $104 billion net loss and nearly $900 billion in infrastructure commitments.

stories.headline: OpenAI Unifies ChatGPT Chat and Work Interfaces
stories.blurb: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs into a single workflow space while consolidating usage allowances across ChatGPT and Codex.

stories.headline: Microsoft Migrates Copilot Cowork Runtime from Python to Rust Live
stories.blurb: Microsoft converted its agentic execution layer to Rust while running in production, improving system performance and demonstrating effective agent isolation and testing techniques.

stories.headline: Active Exploitation Hits Over 1,000 Unpatched GitLab Servers
stories.blurb: Attackers are actively targeting a maximum-severity remote code execution flaw in GitLab's CI/CD compiler, leading CISA to add the vulnerability to its known exploited list.

stories.headline: Critical Langflow Vulnerabilities Allow Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
stories.blurb: Two flaws in Langflow permit unauthenticated attackers to bypass login screens and run arbitrary code on servers via Model Context Protocol tool enumeration.

stories.headline: WorkOS Discloses Breach Executed by AI-Assisted Attack Framework
stories.blurb: WorkOS suffered unauthorized access to an internal sales application after threat actors used an automated AI security framework for reconnaissance and exploitation.

stories.headline: Cyberattack Triggers Mass Defrosting in European Supermarket Freezers
stories.blurb: A coordinated attack switched industrial refrigeration units to defrost mode across seven European nations, spoiling inventory and forcing physical infrastructure repairs.

stories.headline: Cloudflare Cuts DNS Build Latency and Drops Peak Memory Use 85%
stories.blurb: Cloudflare replaced full DNS zone rebuilds with targeted update planning, significantly reducing memory consumption and halving propagation delays for DNS edits.

stories.headline: Next.js 16.4 Uses AI Agent Skill to Trim Client JavaScript Bundles
stories.blurb: Vercel released a Turbopack-integrated agent skill in Next.js 16.4 that analyzes module import graphs and automatically refactors hidden dependencies to accelerate page loads.

stories.headline: Google Brings Custom TPUs to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
stories.blurb: Google and Oracle expanded their cloud alliance to host Google Tensor Processing Units on OCI, giving enterprise developers more options for training and inference.

stories.headline: Figma Leverages Reinforcement Learning for Native Design Editing Model
stories.blurb: Figma trained a first-party editing model using RL that completes iterative UI design tasks 20% faster while reducing user undo actions by 60%.

stories.headline: Canva Unveils Brush Vision Model to Cut Design Editing Costs
stories.blurb: Canva launched Brush, a proprietary vision-language model designed to edit multi-page layouts 69% faster and at 46% lower compute costs per task.

stories.headline: Nielsen Norman Group Urges Broadening UX to Experience Design for AI Agents
stories.blurb: NN/g advises digital product teams to expand UX frameworks beyond direct human interactions to account for automated AI agents acting as intermediaries.
